name: Cursor
description: AI-first code editor built on VS Code. Inline code generation, chat with codebase, intelligent autocomplete.
pro_tip: Use Cmd+K for inline edits and Cmd+L for chat. The 'codebase' context option lets you ask questions about your entire project.

name: GitHub Copilot
description: AI pair programmer that suggests code completions as you type. Integrates with VS Code, JetBrains, and Neovim.
pro_tip: Write a comment describing what you want before the function. Copilot uses comments as hints for generation.

name: Claude Artifacts
description: Interactive code, documents, and visualizations generated in real-time. Can create working apps, charts, and prototypes.
pro_tip: Ask Claude to create a 'standalone HTML file' for quick prototypes. It can include CSS and JS in a single file.

name: v0 by Vercel
description: AI-powered UI component generator. Describe what you want, get production-ready React/Tailwind code.
pro_tip: Be specific about the UI framework (React, Next.js) and styling approach (Tailwind, CSS modules) in your prompt.

name: Perplexity AI
description: AI-powered search engine with citations. Combines real-time web search with AI synthesis.
pro_tip: Use 'Pro Search' for complex questions. It does multi-step research and cites every claim.

name: Midjourney
description: AI image generation from text prompts. Known for artistic, high-quality outputs.
pro_tip: Use --style raw for more literal interpretations. Add --chaos 50 for more varied outputs. Aspect ratio with --ar 16:9.

name: DALL-E 3
description: OpenAI's image generation model. Strong at following detailed instructions and text rendering in images.
pro_tip: DALL-E 3 is best at rendering text in images. Be very specific about composition and style.

name: Whisper
description: Open-source speech-to-text model. Supports 99 languages. Can run locally.
pro_tip: Use the large-v3 model for best accuracy. For real-time, use faster-whisper which is 4x faster.

name: ElevenLabs
description: AI voice cloning and text-to-speech. Natural-sounding voices with emotion control.
pro_tip: Clone your own voice with just 1 minute of audio. Use the 'stability' slider to control expressiveness.

name: Runway ML
description: AI video generation and editing. Gen-3 Alpha creates videos from text or images.
pro_tip: Start with image-to-video for more control. Generate a still image first, then animate it.

name: LangChain
description: Framework for building LLM applications. Chains, agents, memory, and retrieval.
pro_tip: Start with LCEL (LangChain Expression Language) for new projects. It's more composable than the older chain classes.

name: LlamaIndex
description: Data framework for LLM applications. Connect LLMs to your data sources for RAG.
pro_tip: Use the 'sentence window' retrieval for better context. Default chunking often splits related sentences.

name: Ollama
description: Run LLMs locally with one command. Supports Llama, Mistral, Gemma, and more.
pro_tip: Use 'ollama pull llama3' to download, then 'ollama serve' to start the API server. Works with any OpenAI-compatible client.

name: Open WebUI
description: Self-hosted web UI for Ollama and OpenAI-compatible APIs. ChatGPT-like interface for local models.
pro_tip: Install with Docker: 'docker run -d -p 3000:8080 ghcr.io/open-webui/open-webui:main'. Connects to Ollama automatically.

name: ComfyUI
description: Node-based UI for Stable Diffusion. Visual workflow builder for image generation pipelines.
pro_tip: Start with pre-built workflows from the community. The node-based approach is powerful but steep learning curve.

name: Weights & Biases
description: ML experiment tracking, model management, and data versioning.
pro_tip: Use 'wandb.init(project='my-project')' at the start of training. Automatic logging works with PyTorch, TensorFlow, and HuggingFace.

name: Hugging Face Transformers
description: Library of 500K+ pre-trained models for NLP, vision, audio, and multimodal tasks.
pro_tip: Use 'pipeline()' for quick prototyping. Switch to model classes for production with fine-tuning.

name: Notion AI
description: AI writing assistant integrated into Notion. Summarize, draft, brainstorm, and edit content.
pro_tip: Use '/ai' command in any Notion page. Select text first to get contextual actions like 'improve writing' or 'make shorter.'

name: Grammarly
description: AI writing assistant for grammar, clarity, tone, and style. Works in browser and desktop apps.
pro_tip: The tone detector is underrated — it tells you how your message will be perceived before you send it.

name: Phind
description: AI search engine for developers. Combines web search with code generation.
pro_tip: Use 'Expert' mode for complex technical questions. It searches documentation and Stack Overflow before generating answers.

name: Continue
description: Open-source AI code assistant. Works with VS Code and JetBrains. Supports any LLM.
pro_tip: Configure it to use your local Ollama instance for free, private code assistance. Set 'provider: ollama' in config.

name: Aider
description: AI pair programming in your terminal. Edit code with natural language using any LLM.
pro_tip: Use 'aider --model ollama/llama3' for free local editing. The --watch flag lets you use comments in code as prompts.
